24:28.text: And if you do not find anyone therein, do not enter them until permission has been given you. And if it is said to you, "Go back,"
then go back; it is purer for you. And Allāh is Knowing of what you do.

24:29.text: There is no blame upon you for entering houses not inhabited in which there is convenience
for you. And Allāh knows what you reveal and what you conceal.

24:30.text: Tell the believing men to reduce
That is purer for them. Indeed, Allāh is

24:31.text: And tell the believing women to reduce
and guard their private parts and not expose their adornment
their headcovers over their chests and not expose their adornment

except to their husbands, their fathers, their husbands' fathers, their sons, their husbands' sons, their brothers, their brothers' sons, their sisters' sons, their women, that which their right hands possess
, or those male attendants having no physical desire,

or children who are not yet aware of the private aspects of women. And let them not stamp their feet to make known what they conceal of their adornment. And turn to Allāh in repentance, all of you, O believers, that you might succeed.
